description: "Coralie" by Charlotte M. Brame is a novel likely written in the late 19th century. The story centers around Sir Edgar Trevelyan, a young man who finds himself thrust into sudden wealth and responsibility when he learns he is the heir to the property and title of Crown Anstey after the death of his wealthy relatives.
